issue.title: [Syncd failed during boot] syncd#supervisord: syncd /usr/bin/syncd: error while loading shared libraries: libprotobuf.so.10: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory#015

failure.body:
**Description**
Starting with BRCM cached build 144 syncd fails to boot up. Syslog shows the following error:
```
Dec 19 <IPV6>.674639 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- main: Enabling synchronous mode
Dec 19 <IPV6>.675629 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- main: --- Starting Orchestration Agent ---
Dec 19 <IPV6>.677173 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- loadFromFile: no context config specified, will load default context config
Dec 19 <IPV6>.701299 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- insert: added switch: 0:
Dec 19 <IPV6>.731777 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- RedisChannel: creating notification thread
Dec 19 <IPV6>.738778 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- clear_local_state: clearing local state
Dec 19 <IPV6>.755610 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- stopRecording: stopped recording

Dec 19 <IPV6>.770226 str-s6000-acs-8 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- notifySyncd: sending syncd: INIT_VIEW
Dec 19 <IPV6>.046110 str-s6000-acs-8 INFO pmon#/supervisord: start Installing collected packages: sonic-platform
Dec 19 <IPV6>.229909 str-s6000-acs-8 WARNING systemd[1]: Configuration file /lib/systemd/system/copp-config.service is marked executable. Please remove executable permission bits. Proceeding anyway.
```
